column1: 57               A Midsummer Night’s Dream           ACT 2. SC. 2
For I upon this bank will rest my head.
One turf shall serve as pillow for us both;
One heart, one bed, two bosoms, and one troth.
Nay, good Lysander. For my sake, my dear,
Lie further off yet. Do not lie so near.                                                 50
O, take the sense, sweet, of my innocence! Love takes the meaning in love’s conference. I mean that my heart unto yours   is   knit,
So that but one heart we can make of it;
Two bosoms interchainèd with an oath—                                          55
So then two bosoms and a single troth. Then by your side no bed-room me deny, For lying so, Hermia, I do not lie.
